newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PUBLICO SLIDES AFTER DEAL ANNOUNCED.
newsitem.headline: PUBLICO SLIDES AFTER DEAL ANNOUNCED.

text.p: Shares in specialist publishing group, Publico Ltd, fell at the start of trade on Thursday after a heady rise on Wednesday on rumours it was to be part of a deal, which was confirmed after the close of trade.
In the first few minutes of the session Publico fell over 10 percent or 45 cents to 400 cents in slim volume of 6,400 shares.
"It's just guys taking a bit of profits on the news of the Primedia buy. I'm sure it'll work its way back up again this afternoon," a dealer said.
Media firm Primedia Ltd said late on Wednesday it had acquired a strategic 34.9 percent stake in Publico Holdings Ltd (Pubhold), the holding company of Publico.
The acquisition price was not disclosed and Primedia said the deal was not expected to have a material impact on its earnings in the short-term.
Shares in Publico surged 85 cents to close at 445 on Wednesday as news of a deal seeped into the market, although much of the talk was that Publico would be the one making the acquisition.

Volumes were brisk on Wednesday with over 350,000 shares trading in Publico which is 75 percent owned by Pubhold. Pubhold shares jumped in tandem gaining 240 cents to 600 cents after 23,200 shares had traded.
But on Thursday Pubhold also toppled off its highs losing 25 percent of their value to 450 cents.
